verified_claims.claim: Taxol 抑制细胞周期 G2-M 期，阻断有丝分裂；FDA 1992 年批准
verified_claims.evidence: Taxol inhibits cell proliferation at the G2-M phase of the cell cycle, thereby blocking mitosis... FDA approval of Taxol in 1992

verified_claims.claim: 商业分离 1 kg Taxol 需约 6.7 t T. brevifolia 树皮，相当于 2,000–3,000 棵树
verified_claims.evidence: the commercial isolation of 1 kg of Taxol required about 6.7 t of T. brevifolia bark, equivalent to 2,000–3,000 trees

verified_claims.claim: 10-DABIII 以 0.1% 干重得率自 T. baccata/T. yunnanensis 针叶分离
verified_claims.evidence: obtained by isolation in suitable yield (0.1% dry weight) from the needles of wild or cultivated T. baccata (European yew) and T. yunnanensis

verified_claims.claim: 紫杉二烯合酶为 79-kDa 二萜环化酶，含 N-端质体靶向序列
verified_claims.evidence: taxadiene synthase, a 79-kDa diterpene cyclase... bears an N-terminal plastid targeting sequence

verified_claims.claim: 从 T. cuspidata 分离 22 个全长 P450 cDNA，其中 16 个异源表达；两个功能 P450 克隆同源性 63% identity / 67% similarity
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.3 左栏–右栏
verified_claims.evidence: led to the isolation of 22 closely related, full-length cytochrome P450 cDNA species... Heterologous expression of 16 of these cytochrome P450 cDNA clones... 63% identity, 67% similarity

verified_claims.claim: Ketchum et al. 1999 报道经甲基茉莉酸诱导后 Taxol 生产速率达 23.4 mg L⁻¹ day⁻¹，Taxol 占总紫杉烷 13–20%
verified_claims.evidence: Taxol production rates of up to 23.4 mg l–1 day–1, after elicitation of the cell culture with methyl jasmonate, have been reported (Ketchum et al. 1999), with Taxol comprising 13–20% of the total taxoid fraction

verified_claims.claim: IND 5109 由稀有天然紫杉烷 10-脱乙酰基-14α-羟基巴卡丁 III 衍生而来，对多药耐药肿瘤细胞系无交叉耐药
verified_claims.evidence: Another interesting new Taxol analogue is IND 5109 (Fig. 5, compound 5), derived from the rare, naturally occurring taxoid 10-deacetyl-14α-hydroxybaccatin III... IDN 5109 showed no cross-resistance to Taxol or doxorubicin

verified_claims.claim: Figure 2 由子图 a–e 标注 a 紫杉二烯合酶、b P450 taxadiene 5α-羟基化酶、c taxa-4(20),11(12)-dien-5α-o-乙酰基转移酶、d P450 taxane-13α-羟基化酶、e P450 taxane-10β-羟基化酶
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.3 图 2a–e 标题
verified_claims.evidence: Fig. 2a–e Outline of the Taxol biosynthetic pathway. The enzymes indicated are: a taxadiene synthase, b cytochrome P450 taxadiene 5α-hydroxylase (involving allylic rearrangement), c taxa-4(20),11(12)-dien-5α-o-acetyl transferase, d cytochrome P450 taxane-13α-hydroxylase, and e cytochrome P450 taxane-10β-hydroxylase

verified_claims.claim: D-环形成最被支持机制：5α-乙酸酯的 4(20)-双键环氧化 → α-乙酰氧基由 C-5 迁移至 C-4 → 环氧乙烷-氧杂环丁烷环扩张
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 p.4 左栏（图 3 说明）
verified_claims.evidence: involving the epoxidation of the 4(20)-double bond of the 5α-acetate, followed by a rearrangement in which the α-acetoxy group migrates from C-5 to C-4, accompanied by the oxirane-to-oxetane ring expansion

verified_claims.claim: 5α、10β、9、2 位羟基化早于 C-13 位；1、7 位为晚期事件；氧化精确顺序未确立
verified_claims.evidence: hydroxylations at positions C-5, C-10, C-9, and C-2 represent early steps of the Taxol pathway, which precede hydroxylation at C-13; and hydroxylation at the C-1 and C-7 positions of the taxane ring are considered to represent relatively late steps in Taxol biosynthesis... the precise order of hydroxylation steps and the true intermediates of the Taxol pathway clearly cannot be regarded as firmly established
